items.informal_name: Commutativity of Partial Derivatives with Evaluation in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) (f : τ → S) (j : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X (⇑MvPolynomial.C ∘ f))) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl j)) p) =
    (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X (⇑MvPolynomial.C ∘ f))) p)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial $ p $ in variables $ \sigma \oplus \tau $ with coefficients in a commutative ring $ R $, and an $ R $-algebra homomorphism evaluating variables in $ \tau $ via a function $ f : \tau \to S $, the partial derivative of $ p $ with respect to $ j \in \sigma $ commutes with evaluation. Specifically, evaluating the partial derivative $ \partial_{\text{inl}(j)} p $ using the homomorphism that maps $ \sigma $-variables to themselves and $ \tau $-variables via $ f $ is equivalent to first evaluating $ p $ under this homomorphism and then taking the partial derivative with respect to $ j $. This establishes $ \text{aeval}(\partial_{\text{inl}(j)} p) = \partial_j(\text{aeval}(p)) $ in the target algebra $ S $.

items.informal_name: Equality of Evaluations for Sum of Iterated Derivatives via Algebra Homomorphism
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (A : Type u_3) [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (p : Polynomial R)
  (r : A),
  (Polynomial.aeval r) (Polynomial.sumIDeriv p) =
    Polynomial.eval r (Polynomial.sumIDeriv (Polynomial.map (algebraMap R A) p))
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ and any element $ r $ in an $ R $-algebra $ A $, evaluating the sum of iterated derivatives of $ p $ at $ r $ via the algebra homomorphism equals evaluating the sum of iterated derivatives of the polynomial $ p $ with coefficients mapped through the canonical algebra homomorphism $ R \to A $ at $ r $.

items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.informal_name: Derivative of Polynomial Evaluation Equals Evaluation of Derivative
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {x : 𝕜} {R : Type u_1} [inst_1 : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R 𝕜] (q : Polynomial R),
  fderiv 𝕜 (fun x => (Polynomial.aeval x) q) x =
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight 1 ((Polynomial.aeval x) (Polynomial.derivative q))
items.informal_description: The Fréchet derivative of the function that evaluates a polynomial $ q $ at a point $ x $ is equal to the evaluation of the derivative of $ q $ at $ x $.

items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) (f : τ → S) (j : σ) : (MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X (⇑MvPolynomial.C ∘ f))) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl j)) p) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X (⇑MvPolynomial.C ∘ f))) p)
